items.title: U.S. businesses created the fewest new jobs in 7 months, ADP says. Hiring slowed in the summer.
items.content: U.S. businesses created just 38,000 new jobs in August, ADP said, the second small increase in a row, pointing to a slowdown in hiring during the summer.

items.title: We’re in our 60s. My wife and I have $345,000 in annual pensions and $1 million in 403(b)s. Is it too late for Roth conversions?
items.content: “Roth assets would provide our children with tax-free distributions.”

items.title: ‘I feel shoehorned’: My father funded my $800,000 Roth IRA. Does that give him the right to say how I invest it?
items.content: “His argument is essentially that, since my parents provided the money for the Roth, they have a say in how I invest it.”

items.title: America’s renter generation is trying to build wealth by investing in stocks instead of owning a house
items.content: They have a new personal finance script they are following — that doesn’t include a white picket fence.

items.title: Which workers are using AI surprisingly often? Dry cleaners and construction workers.
items.content: The adoption of artificial intelligence at work has been widespread, but more “shallow” than expected — for now.

items.title: How these homeowners pulled off buying a house in their early 20s
items.content: Despite typical first-time buyers navigating a challenging housing market in recent history, a growing number of young adults have been able to become homeowners.

items.title: ‘It’s not fair’: My twin brother and I were left houses by our parents. Can I make him pay his share for taxes and upkeep?
items.content: “I am frustrated and financially exhausted from continuing to invest my own money into these properties.”

items.title: Stocks that rise when the S&P 500 falls are keeping up with the rest of Wall Street. It’s weird.
items.content: So-called negative-beta stocks are thriving and offer a way to ride out volatility events, says one strategist.

items.title: How one strategist warned on semiconductor stocks within a day of their top
items.content: The chairman of JPMorgan Asset Management’s market and investment strategy warned on chip stocks within a day of their peak.

items.title: Europe’s largest airline warns of jet-fuel prices hitting $140 this winter as it cuts capacity
items.content: Ryanair on Wednesday reduced its winter capacity to mitigate its exposure to unhedged jet fuel prices of $140 per barrel, illustrating a major economic impact of the energy crisis.
